title: Chamfer on a Milling Machine

inputs.angleHint: Half of the included angle: 30° = 60° tool, 45° = 90°, 60° = 120°.

results.title: Results
results.offsetNote: Radius of the tool centre path. Path diameter: {{d}}
results.activeRadiusNote: This is what the active correction (table + DR/offset) must show. Diameter: {{d}}
results.contourRadiusNote: This is the hole edge — turn on compensation and make sure the active tool radius equals the value above.
results.drNote: Table radius: {{r0}}. Enter this correction in your control's field (DR on Heidenhain, radius/wear offset on Haas/Fanuc, OFFN on Sinumerik).
results.drMissing: Enter the diameter registered in the table to calculate the correction.
results.chamferNoDr: Dedicated chamfer tool: set the table radius to {{e}}. No extra correction is needed.

warnings.toolTooSmall: The chamfer mill is too small. This chamfer needs a working diameter of at least {{required}}, the tool has {{tool}}. Largest chamfer for this tool: {{max}}.
warnings.safetyTooBig: The safety allowance is too large for this hole (max {{max}}). Reduce it.
warnings.invalidAngle: Tool angle must be between 1° and 89°.
warnings.drPositive: The correction is positive — it increases the radius beyond the table value. This is unusual, double-check before running.

status.toolOk: The tool is sufficient (uses {{used}} of {{tool}} diameter).
status.toolMissing: Enter the chamfer mill diameter to check whether it is large enough.

empty: Enter the hole diameter and chamfer width to see the results.
note: Assumes a sharp tool tip and Z zero at the tip. For blind holes make sure the hole is deeper than Z.

program.title: Programming method
program.toolModeInfoChamfer: Chamfer tool: the control knows the tool's angle and geometry (a dedicated table entry). The table radius can be set directly to the calculated value — no extra correction needed.
program.toolModeInfoEndmill: End mill: the chamfer tool is registered in the table like a plain end mill, e.g. "End mill 8" = 4 mm radius. The real working radius differs from the table value, so a correction is needed (Heidenhain: DR; Haas/Fanuc: radius/wear offset; Sinumerik: OFFN; Mazatrol: usually just a different radius in the tool data).
program.toolModeIrrelevant: In "Center (no compensation)" mode this choice doesn't change the result — it only matters with radius compensation.
program.tableDia: Diameter registered in the table (e.g. "End mill 8")
program.pathModeInfoCenter: Center (no compensation): the program gives the tool centre path radius directly. Compensation is off (G40).
program.pathModeInfoComp: Compensation: the program gives the hole edge contour itself, and the control offsets the tool by its active radius. Heidenhain: RL/RR + DR. Haas/Fanuc: G41/G42 + radius offset (D). Sinumerik: G41/G42 + OFFN. Mazatrol: usually just enter the tool radius in the tool data.

verifyNote: Before running at full feed, verify the position in single block / simulation.
